parsed.note_claim: Harry and Meghan are private citizens per official Palace guidance issued on the King's behalf; their charitable work is undertaken in a private capacity.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: The charitable work of the Duke and Duchess is a personal matter for them both and undertaken in their private capacity. In short, their position is akin to private citizens with commercial and charitable interests.
parsed.reason: The article quotes the official Palace letter confirming their status as private citizens and that their charitable work is undertaken in a private capacity.
